techniques.name: Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Transformers for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (A2C quantum/hybrid transformer)
techniques.capability_enabled: Hybrid classical-quantum Advantage Actor-Critic agent with self/cross-attention transformer to solve CVRP, producing more robust route organization than a classical baseline
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights for this paper found; the only GitHub repo returned (SMU-Quantum/adaptive_quantum_cvrp) is explicitly described as a different research project.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The paper addresses the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) by comparing classical and quantum Reinforcement Learning approaches, implementing an Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C) agent in classical, full quantum, and hybrid variants that integrate transformer architectures to capture relationships between vehicles, clients, and the depot through self- and cross-attention mechanisms.

techniques.name: MPSF-FL: Enhancing Cross-Problem Vehicle Routing via Federated Learning (Multi-problem Pre-train, then Single-problem Fine-tune)
techniques.capability_enabled: Federated multi-problem pre-train then single-problem fine-tune framework that mitigates performance degradation and generalizability decay when transferring neural VRP solvers from simple to complex-constraint VRP variants
techniques.code_evidence: Search returned only the arXiv HTML page; no GitHub/HF code link visible in result blocks.
techniques.verbatim_quote: The paper proposes an innovative "Multi-problem Pre-train, then Single-problem Fine-tune" framework with Federated Learning (MPSF-FL) to address the issue that current cross-problem learning paradigms suffer from performance degradation and generalizability decay when transferring from simple VRP variants to those with different and complex constraints.

techniques.name: Event-based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling with Random Job Arrivals (PPO + MLP)
techniques.capability_enabled: Event-based DRL (PPO with MLPs) for flexible job shop scheduling under random job arrivals, minimizing total job completion time and outperforming individual dispatching rules across heterogeneity/arrival-rate regimes
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link visible in result blocks; search summary explicitly noted results do not mention open source code for this paper.
techniques.verbatim_quote: A May 2026 paper proposes an event-based Deep Reinforcement Learning approach to solve flexible job shop scheduling with random job arrivals, using Proximal Policy Optimization and Multi-Layer Perceptrons to minimize total job completion time.

techniques.name: Policy-Based Reinforcement Learning with Action Masking for Dynamic Job Shop Scheduling under Uncertainty (Coloured Timed Petri Nets + Maskable PPO)
techniques.capability_enabled: Maskable PPO over Coloured Timed Petri Net state representation for dynamic job shop scheduling under uncertainty (random arrivals, machine failures), restricting agents to feasible actions for makespan minimization
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link visible in result blocks.
techniques.verbatim_quote: Another January 2026 paper presents a framework for dynamic job shop scheduling under uncertainty, using Coloured Timed Petri Nets and Maskable Proximal Policy Optimization to enable dynamic decision-making while restricting agents to feasible actions.

techniques.name: PMAx: An Agentic Framework for AI-Driven Process Mining
techniques.capability_enabled: Closed-loop agentic (LLM) orchestration for process mining that bridges process semantics and technical implementation while mitigating LLM hallucinations, limited context windows, and privacy concerns
techniques.code_evidence: Result block states: code and evaluation are available on GitHub at https://github.com/fit-process-mining/PMAx-evaluation (preprint submitted to EMMSAD 2026 tool demonstration).
techniques.verbatim_quote: The code and evaluation are available on GitHub at https://github.com/fit-process-mining/PMAx-evaluation.
